```yaml
name: "Codex Review: Notify Code Owner"

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Load Secrets
        uses: 1password/load-secrets-action@v3
        with:
          export-env: true

      - name: Generate AI Review
        uses: actions/ai-inference@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a senior DevOps engineer reviewing a pull request for the Asymmetric-al/core repository. The PR updates agent instruction routing to align with Next 16.x and MCP. Based on the provided summary and Greptile analysis, please provide a concise review focusing on:

            1. Documentation alignment with Next.js versioning (specifically the discrepancy between AGENTS.md stating next@16.1.6 vs. working-set.md and general.md showing 16.2.1)
            2. Correctness of MCP configuration changes (particularly the -y flag fix in both .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json)
            3. Overall quality of documentation improvements including source-of-truth ordering, Nia workflow guidance, and skill routing updates
            4. Compliance with verification requirements (skills:verify passing, preservation of managed blocks)
            
            Please focus on whether these changes are safe to merge and identify any critical issues that need attention before merging.
          model: "gpt-4o"
          max-tokens: 1000
          enable-github-mcp: true
          github-mcp-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          
      - name: Comment on Pull Request
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const { response } = require('./response.json');
            
            const comment = `
### 📝 Codex Review Summary

${response}

> ⚠️ **Critical Issue**: AGENTS.md contains a version mismatch. It states \`next@16.1.6\` while the repository has been on \`16.2.1\` since 2026-03-22. This should be updated to maintain consistency with \`docs/ai/working-set.md\` and \`docs/ai/rules/general.md\`.
            
> ✅ **Verification Status**: 
> - [ ] \`bun run skills:verify\` passes
> - [ ] Next.js managed block and \`NEXT-AGENTS-MD\` region in \`AGENTS.md\` preserved verbatim
> - [ ] MCP configuration fixes verified (tanstack -y flag)
> - [ ] Skill routing updates validated
            `;
            
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });
```
